scope: Native motor API, recovery geometry, narrow forearm contact and normal manual-input regression; not universal anatomical or damage validation

checks: diagonal coordinates match native API contract and quaternion sign
quaternion sign changes do not command motion
179 to -179 degrees takes the two-degree motor path
velocity uses the parent-frame left quaternion difference
changing the common world frame leaves relative commands unchanged
first call and zero time have finite zero velocity, and update history
existing position-error and axis-rate budgets are retained
asin domain clamp prevents f32 component overshoot from producing NaN
nativeContracts.scope: Isolated npm spherical motor coordinates, parent-axis target velocity, and finite-state checks. No gameplay or anatomical acceptance.

normalInput.scope: Same authored input, distant idle opponent, firstCut+hold / reverse+hold / recut+hold windows. General policy uses lightsaber legacy and monohoshizao v2. Values are observed changes, not automatic gameplay acceptance; no thresholds relaxed.

remainingWeapons.scope: Actual ordinary policy, same one-tape request for healthy estoc/excalibur/excalibur_replica/frozen_tuna. Distant idle longsword foe. No contact damage; no relaxed thresholds.

lightsaberAblation.scope: Three independently simulated same-input healthy lightsaber legacy runs; source baseline, motor-coordinate-only, full motor+reach+forearm-contact. No native contact damage. Active-input phases distinguished from no-motion held phases; dynamics nonlinear so effects not additive.
